mapper.select: SELECT sw.student_id as "studentId", cce.coach_id as "coachId", cce.course_id as "courseId", sw.user_course_package_id as "userCoursePackageId", cce.id as "sessionEventId", cce.title as "title", cce.start_ts::timestamp as "startTs", cce.end_ts::timestamp as "endTs", cce.capacity as "capacity", cce.booked_count as "bookedCount", sw.position as "waitlistPosition", sw.created_at::timestamp as "waitlistCreatedAt" FROM public.session_waitlist sw JOIN public.coach_calendar_event cce ON cce.id = sw.event_id WHERE cce.kind = 'session' AND sw.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY cce.start_ts ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM public.session_waitlist WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.select: SELECT slot_start as "slotStart", slot_end as "slotEnd", duration_minutes as "durationMinutes" FROM public.get_availability_available_slots(#{availabilityId}) ORDER BY slot_start ASC

SELECT sb.student_id as "studentId", cce.coach_id as "coachId", sb.user_course_package_id as "userCoursePackageId", cce.id as "availabilityEventId", cce.title as "title", sb.booked_start_time as "bookedStartTime", sb.booked_end_time as "bookedEndTime", sb.status as "bookingStatus", sb.booked_at as "bookedAt", sb.cancelled_at as "cancelledAt", cce.location as "location" FROM public.session_booking sb JOIN public.coach_calendar_event cce ON cce.id = sb.event_id WHERE cce.kind = 'availability' AND sb.student_id = #{studentId} AND sb.status = 'CONFIRMED' ORDER BY sb.booked_start_time ASC

WITH booked_sessions AS ( -- Session预约 SELECT cce.id, 'session' as kind, cce.title, cce.course_id as courseId, cce.title as courseName, -- 使用coach_calendar_event的title作为课程名称 cce.location, cce.start_ts as startTime, cce.end_ts as endTime, COUNT(sb.id) as studentCount, cce.capacity as maxCapacity, ARRAY_AGG(up.user_id::text) as studentNames FROM public.coach_calendar_event cce JOIN public.session_booking sb ON cce.id = sb.event_id JOIN public.user_course_package ucp ON sb.user_course_package_id = ucp.id JOIN public.user_profile up ON ucp.user_id = up.user_id WHERE cce.coach_id = #{coachId} AND cce.kind = 'session' AND sb.status = 'CONFIRMED' GROUP BY cce.id, cce.title, cce.course_id, cce.location, cce.start_ts, cce.end_ts, cce.capacity
UNION ALL
-- Availability预约 SELECT cce.id, 'availability' as kind, cce.title, NULL as courseId, 'Availability' as courseName, cce.location, sb.booked_start_time as startTime, sb.booked_end_time as endTime, 1 as studentCount, 1 as maxCapacity, ARRAY[up.user_id::text] as studentNames FROM public.coach_calendar_event cce JOIN public.session_booking sb ON cce.id = sb.event_id JOIN public.user_course_package ucp ON sb.user_course_package_id = ucp.id JOIN public.user_profile up ON ucp.user_id = up.user_id WHERE cce.coach_id = #{coachId} AND cce.kind = 'availability' AND sb.status = 'CONFIRMED' ) SELECT id as "id", kind as "kind", title as "title", courseId as "courseId", courseName as "courseName", location as "location", startTime as "startTime", endTime as "endTime", studentCount as "studentCount", maxCapacity as "maxCapacity", studentNames as "studentNames" FROM booked_sessions ORDER BY startTime ASC
